source.source_relationship: official video linked by the verified submission record
source.capture_method: OpenCV sequential decode from exact sought source frame; source frame index retained

state_semantics.held: visualizer cells classified as white-highlighted in this video frame; this is not asserted to be a physical key hold
state_semantics.unknown: cell mean luminance fell in the undecidable interval between inactive and active thresholds
state_semantics.event_compression: complete state emitted at frame 0 and whenever held/unknown sets change

playback_alignment.source_video_frame_alignment: sequential frame index; CFR 60/1 reported by ffprobe

visual_extraction.method: mean grayscale luminance over manually calibrated visualizer cell interior
visual_extraction.roi_coordinate_system: 1920x1080 absolute pixel coordinates, x0/y0 inclusive, x1/y1 exclusive
visual_extraction.calibration_note: Manual inspection confirms the keyboard/mouse overlay. Captions in the action rows change across game states; those cells are stable visual slots, not guessed physical keys.

manual_caption_samples.caption_note: action cells show key-like captions including A/S/D/F/G and Z/X/C/V/B
same cells instead show action captions including Items/QS/Equip/Cncl/Opts/Lvl/Round/Swing/Walk

unknown: Overlay state may represent highlight/tap display rather than sustained physical input.
Frame index follows the official video only; run start, game start, and pauses/loading transitions are not globally aligned.
Game input polling, simulation frame boundary, and hold/release duration are unqualified.
Some visual cells are semantic/ambiguous and intentionally have no score token.
Mouse movement position is not extracted; only labeled LMB/RMB and arrow-like key cells are sampled.

binding_summary.replay_disabled_reason: visual highlight semantics, physical hold duration, game-frame alignment, and initial game state are not qualified
